name: Bodyweight Squat
steps: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart, toes slightly out.
Push your hips back and bend your knees as if sitting on a chair.
Go down until thighs are about parallel to the floor, chest up.
Push through your whole foot to stand up.

name: Hindu Squat (Baithak)
steps: Stand with feet hip-width apart, arms out in front.
Rise onto the balls of your feet as you squat down, swinging the arms back.
Touch the heels lightly at the bottom, then stand up swinging the arms forward.
Keep a steady rhythm with your breathing.
mistakes: Going too fast and losing balance

name: Chair Box Squat
hinglish: chair squat, box squat, kursi squat
steps: Stand in front of a sturdy chair, feet shoulder-width.
Sit back slowly until your hips lightly touch the chair.
Pause without relaxing, then stand up tall.
Lower the chair height (or add a cushion) to adjust difficulty.

name: Goblet Squat
steps: Hold one dumbbell (or a full water can) at your chest with both hands.
Squat down between your hips, elbows inside the knees.
Keep the chest tall and the weight close.
Drive up through the heels.
mistakes: Letting the weight pull you forward

name: Sumo Squat
steps: Stand with feet wide, toes turned out.
Lower straight down, pushing knees out over the toes.
Keep the chest up and back straight.
Squeeze the glutes to stand.

name: Reverse Lunge
steps: Stand tall, hands on hips.
Step one foot back and lower until both knees are bent about 90°.
Keep the front shin vertical and torso upright.
Push through the front heel to return. Alternate legs.
mistakes: Front knee shooting past the toes

name: Walking Lunge
steps: Step forward into a lunge, back knee close to the floor.
Push off the front foot and bring the back leg through into the next lunge.
Take long steps and keep the torso upright.
Walk 10 steps per leg.
mistakes: Short steps that overload the knee

name: Side Lunge
steps: Stand with feet together.
Take a big step to the side and bend that knee, sitting the hips back.
Keep the other leg straight and both feet flat.
Push back to the start and switch sides.

name: Step-up
steps: Stand facing a stair or sturdy low step.
Place your whole foot on the step.
Drive through that heel to stand up on the step.
Step down slowly and repeat; switch legs.
mistakes: Pushing off with the back foot

name: Glute Bridge
steps: Lie on your back, knees bent, feet flat hip-width apart.
Press through your heels and lift your hips.
Squeeze the glutes at the top and pause 1 second.
Lower slowly.

name: Single-leg Glute Bridge
steps: Lie on your back, one knee bent, the other leg straight.
Lift your hips using the bent leg.
Keep the hips level at the top.
Lower slowly; switch legs.

name: Wall Sit
steps: Lean your back flat against a wall.
Slide down until knees are bent about 90°.
Keep feet flat and knees over the ankles.
Hold, breathing steadily.

name: Standing Calf Raise
steps: Stand tall, holding a wall or chair for balance.
Rise up onto the balls of your feet.
Pause at the top, then lower slowly below level if on a step.

name: Donkey Kick
steps: Start on hands and knees.
Keeping the knee bent, lift one foot towards the ceiling.
Squeeze the glute at the top without arching the back.
Lower and repeat; switch legs.

name: Fire Hydrant
steps: Start on hands and knees.
Lift one bent knee out to the side to hip height.
Keep the hips level and core tight.
Lower slowly; switch sides.

name: Push-up
steps: Hands slightly wider than shoulders, body in a straight line from head to heels.
Lower your chest towards the floor, elbows about 45° from the body.
Stop just above the floor.
Press back up without letting the hips sag.

name: Hindu Push-up (Dand)
steps: Start in a downward-dog shape: hands and feet on the floor, hips high.
Bend the elbows and swoop the chest forward close to the floor.
Finish with arms straight and chest lifted, like a cobra.
Push the hips back up to the start.

name: Incline Push-up
hinglish: incline push up, wall push up, table push up
steps: Place hands on a sturdy table, bed edge or wall.
Walk the feet back so the body is straight.
Lower your chest to the edge, then press back.
The higher the surface, the easier it is.

name: Knee Push-up
hinglish: knee push up, ghutne pe pushup
steps: Start on hands and knees, then walk the hands forward so the body is straight from head to knees.
Lower the chest towards the floor.
Press back up, keeping the hips in line.

name: Close-grip Push-up
steps: Hands under the shoulders (or touching in a diamond).
Lower with elbows brushing the ribs.
Press back up, body straight.

name: Chair Dips
steps: Sit on the edge of a sturdy chair, hands beside your hips.
Slide forward off the seat, knees bent.
Bend the elbows to lower your hips, then press back up.

name: Dumbbell Floor Press
steps: Lie on your back, knees bent, a dumbbell in each hand.
Start with elbows on the floor, then press the weights up.
Lower until the elbows touch the floor, pause, press again.

name: Dumbbell Curl
steps: Stand tall with dumbbells (or filled bottles) at your sides.
Keeping elbows still, curl the weights up.
Squeeze at the top, lower slowly.

name: Overhead Triceps Extension
steps: Hold one dumbbell overhead with both hands.
Keeping elbows pointing forward, lower it behind your head.
Straighten the arms to press it back up.

name: Backpack Row
steps: Fill a backpack with books and hold it by the handle or straps.
Hinge forward with a flat back, knees soft.
Pull the bag towards your belly, squeezing the shoulder blades.
Lower slowly.

name: One-arm Dumbbell Row
steps: Place one hand and knee on a bench or chair.
Hold the dumbbell with the other arm hanging.
Row it to your hip, elbow close to the body.
Lower slowly; switch sides.

name: Band / Towel Pulldown
steps: Hold a band or towel overhead, hands wide, pulling it tight.
Pull your elbows down towards your back pockets.
Squeeze the shoulder blades, then return slowly.

name: Superman
steps: Lie face down, arms stretched overhead.
Lift arms, chest and legs a few centimetres off the floor.
Hold 2 seconds, lower slowly.

name: Wall Angels
steps: Stand with your back, head and arms against a wall, elbows bent 90°.
Slide the arms up the wall as far as you can keep contact.
Slide back down slowly.

name: Band Pull-apart
steps: Hold a band in front at shoulder height, arms straight.
Pull it apart until it touches your chest.
Squeeze the shoulder blades and return slowly.

name: Lateral Raise
steps: Stand holding light weights at your sides.
Raise the arms out to the sides to shoulder height, elbows soft.
Lower slowly.
mistakes: Lifting above shoulder height with shrugging

name: Pike Push-up
steps: Start in a downward-dog shape, hips high.
Bend the elbows and lower the top of your head towards the floor between your hands.
Press back up.

name: Plank
steps: Forearms on the floor under the shoulders, legs straight back.
Lift the hips so the body is a straight line.
Squeeze glutes and pull the ribs down.
Breathe and hold.

name: Side Plank
steps: Lie on your side, forearm under the shoulder.
Lift the hips so the body is straight (bend knees to make it easier).
Hold, then switch sides.

name: Dead Bug
steps: Lie on your back, arms up, knees bent 90° in the air.
Slowly lower the opposite arm and leg towards the floor.
Keep the lower back pressed down. Return and switch.
mistakes: Lower back lifting off the floor

name: Bird Dog
steps: Start on hands and knees, back flat.
Reach one arm forward and the opposite leg back.
Hold 2 seconds without tilting the hips, then switch.

name: Crunch
steps: Lie on your back, knees bent, hands lightly by your ears.
Curl your shoulders off the floor using your abs.
Lower slowly.

name: Bicycle Crunch
steps: Lie on your back, hands by your ears, legs raised.
Bring one knee in while twisting the opposite elbow towards it.
Switch sides in a slow pedalling motion.

name: Lying Leg Raise
steps: Lie on your back, legs straight, hands under your hips.
Lift the legs to vertical, keeping them straight.
Lower slowly without letting the back arch.

name: Flutter Kicks
steps: Lie on your back, hands under the hips, legs a little off the floor.
Kick the legs up and down in small, quick movements.
Keep the lower back down.

name: Russian Twist
steps: Sit with knees bent, lean back slightly, chest tall.
Twist the torso to tap your hands beside one hip, then the other.
Lift the feet to make it harder.

name: Heel Touches
steps: Lie on your back, knees bent, shoulders slightly lifted.
Reach one hand down to touch the same-side heel, then the other.
Keep the shoulders up the whole set.

name: Jumping Jacks
steps: Stand with feet together, arms by your sides.
Jump the feet out while raising the arms overhead.
Jump back to the start. Keep a steady rhythm.

name: High Knees
steps: Run on the spot, lifting the knees to hip height.
Pump the arms and stay on the balls of your feet.
Keep the chest up.

name: Butt Kicks
steps: Jog on the spot, kicking your heels up towards your glutes.
Stay light on your feet and keep a quick pace.

name: Burpee
steps: From standing, squat and place your hands on the floor.
Jump the feet back into a plank.
Jump the feet back in and stand up (add a jump for more intensity).

name: Mountain Climbers
steps: Start in a high plank, hands under the shoulders.
Drive one knee towards your chest, then switch quickly.
Keep the hips level.

name: Skipping Rope
steps: Hold the handles at hip height, elbows close.
Turn the rope with your wrists and jump just high enough to clear it.
Land softly on the balls of your feet.

name: Stair Climbing
steps: Walk up a flight of stairs at a steady pace, whole foot on each step.
Walk down carefully, holding the rail.
Repeat for the set time.

name: Brisk Walk / Cycle
hinglish: brisk walk, tez chalna, walking, cycling
steps: Walk (or cycle) at a pace where you can talk but not sing.
Swing the arms and stand tall.
Build up the time week by week.
mistakes: Going too fast and stopping early

name: Low-impact Intervals
hinglish: march, step jacks, low impact cardio
steps: March on the spot or do step-jacks (step one foot out while raising the arms).
Go brisk for 30 seconds.
Slow down for 30 seconds, then repeat.

name: Squat Jump
steps: Squat down with arms back.
Jump up explosively, swinging the arms up.
Land softly and go straight into the next squat.

name: Shadow Boxing
steps: Stand in a boxing stance, hands up by your chin.
Throw straight punches, rotating through the hips.
Keep moving your feet lightly.

name: Kneeling Hip Flexor Stretch
steps: Kneel on one knee, the other foot forward.
Tuck the pelvis slightly and shift the hips forward.
Feel the stretch at the front of the back hip.

name: Standing Hamstring Stretch
steps: Place one heel on a low step, leg straight.
Hinge forward from the hips with a flat back.
Stop when you feel a stretch behind the thigh.

name: Doorway Chest Stretch
steps: Place forearms on a door frame, elbows at shoulder height.
Step one foot through and lean gently forward.
Feel the stretch across the chest.

name: Neck Stretch
steps: Sit tall and relax the shoulders.
Tilt one ear towards the shoulder; gently add the hand for a light stretch.
Repeat on the other side; no forcing.

name: Shoulder Rolls & Arm Circles
hinglish: shoulder rolls, arm circles, kandhe ghumana
steps: Stand tall and roll the shoulders up, back and down.
Then circle straight arms, small to big.
Reverse the direction.

name: World's Greatest Stretch
steps: Step into a deep lunge, both hands on the floor inside the front foot.
Drop the back knee if needed.
Rotate and reach the inside arm to the ceiling, then switch.

name: Figure-4 Glute Stretch
steps: Lie on your back, knees bent.
Cross one ankle over the opposite knee.
Pull the lower leg towards you until you feel the outer hip stretch.

name: Wall Calf Stretch
steps: Hands on a wall, one foot back with the heel down.
Lean forward keeping the back leg straight.
Feel the stretch in the calf.

name: Open Book Rotation
steps: Lie on your side, knees bent at 90°, arms together in front.
Open the top arm to the other side, following it with your eyes.
Return slowly; switch sides.
mistakes: Forcing the arm to the floor

name: Sit-to-stand
steps: Sit on the front of a sturdy chair, feet flat.
Lean slightly forward and stand up without using the hands.
Sit back down slowly.

name: Seated Marching
steps: Sit tall near the front of a chair.
Lift one knee, then the other, like marching.
Swing the arms for more effort.

name: Wall Push-up
steps: Stand an arm's length from a wall, hands on it at shoulder height.
Bend the elbows to bring your chest towards the wall.
Push back to straight arms.

name: Standing Side Leg Raise
steps: Stand holding the back of a chair.
Lift one straight leg out to the side.
Lower slowly; keep the body upright.

name: Heel-to-toe Walk
hinglish: heel to toe walk, tandem walk
steps: Walk in a straight line, placing the heel right in front of the other toe.
Look ahead, arms out for balance.
Stay near a wall or rail.

name: Seated Knee Extension
hinglish: seated knee extension, leg extension at home
steps: Sit tall on a chair.
Straighten one knee until the leg is level, toes up.
Pause, lower slowly; switch legs.

name: Ankle & Wrist Circles
steps: Sit tall, lift one foot slightly.
Draw slow circles with the ankle, then the other way.
Do the same with the wrists.

name: Barbell Bench Press
steps: Lie on the bench, eyes under the bar, feet flat.
Grip slightly wider than shoulders, squeeze the shoulder blades together.
Lower the bar to the lower chest with control.
Press up and slightly back over the shoulders.
mistakes: Bouncing the bar off the chest
avoid_if: shoulder injury (use dumbbells or a spotter)

name: Dumbbell Bench Press
steps: Lie on a bench with a dumbbell in each hand at chest level.
Press up until the arms are straight, weights over the shoulders.
Lower slowly with elbows about 45° from the body.

name: Incline Dumbbell Press
steps: Set the bench to about 30°.
Press the dumbbells up over the upper chest.
Lower slowly to chest level.
mistakes: Bench too steep (turns into a shoulder press)

name: Pec Deck (Chest Fly Machine)
hinglish: pec deck, butterfly, chest fly machine
steps: Sit with your back flat, handles at chest height.
Bring the arms together in a hugging motion.
Squeeze the chest, then open slowly.

name: Cable Crossover
steps: Stand between two high cables, one handle in each hand.
Step forward, slight bend in the elbows.
Bring the hands together in front of the chest, then open slowly.

name: Chest Press Machine
steps: Adjust the seat so handles are at mid-chest.
Press the handles forward until the arms are almost straight.
Return slowly.

name: Parallel Bar Dips
steps: Support yourself on parallel bars, arms straight.
Lean slightly forward and lower until the elbows are at 90°.
Press back up.

name: Lat Pulldown
steps: Sit with thighs under the pads, hands wider than shoulders.
Pull the bar to the upper chest, elbows down and back.
Control the bar back up.

name: Seated Cable Row
steps: Sit tall, feet on the platform, knees slightly bent.
Pull the handle to your belly, elbows close.
Squeeze the shoulder blades, then extend slowly.

name: Chest-supported Row
steps: Lie face down on an incline bench with dumbbells hanging.
Row the weights to your ribs.
Lower slowly.
mistakes: Lifting the chest off the pad

name: Barbell Bent-over Row
steps: Hold the bar, hinge forward with a flat back.
Row the bar to your lower ribs.
Lower with control.

name: Pull-up / Assisted Pull-up
hinglish: pull up, chin up, assisted pull up
steps: Hang from the bar, hands shoulder-width (use the assisted machine or a band if needed).
Pull your chest towards the bar, elbows down.
Lower all the way with control.

name: Deadlift
steps: Stand with mid-foot under the bar, grip just outside the legs.
Brace, flat back, push the floor away to stand up.
Lower by pushing the hips back, bar close to the legs.
mistakes: Bar drifting away from the body

name: Trap-bar Deadlift
steps: Stand inside the trap bar, grip the handles.
Brace and push the floor away to stand tall.
Lower with control.

name: Back Extension
steps: Set the pad at hip level on the extension bench.
Lower the torso with a flat back.
Raise until the body is straight — don't over-arch.

name: Barbell Overhead Press
steps: Bar at the front of the shoulders, grip just outside.
Squeeze glutes, press the bar straight up past your face.
Lock out overhead, then lower to the shoulders.

name: Dumbbell Shoulder Press
steps: Sit tall on a bench, dumbbells at shoulder height.
Press up until the arms are straight.
Lower slowly, wrists over elbows.

name: Landmine Press
steps: Wedge one end of a barbell in a corner; kneel or stand holding the other end at the shoulder.
Press up and slightly forward.
Lower with control.

name: Cable / Dumbbell Lateral Raise
steps: Stand tall with light dumbbells or a low cable.
Raise the arms out to the sides to shoulder height, elbows soft.
Lower slowly.

name: Face Pull
steps: Set a rope at face height.
Pull the rope towards your face, elbows high and wide.
Squeeze the upper back, return slowly.

name: Rear Delt Fly
steps: Hinge forward (or use the reverse pec deck).
Raise the arms out to the sides, slight bend in the elbows.
Lower slowly.

name: Shrugs
steps: Stand holding heavy dumbbells at your sides.
Lift the shoulders straight up towards the ears.
Pause, then lower.

name: Barbell Curl
steps: Stand holding the bar at hip level, palms up.
Curl the bar up, elbows fixed at your sides.
Lower slowly.

name: Hammer Curl
steps: Hold dumbbells with palms facing each other.
Curl up keeping the thumbs on top.
Lower slowly.

name: Preacher Curl
steps: Sit with the back of the upper arms on the preacher pad.
Curl the weight up.
Lower all the way with control.
mistakes: Lifting the elbows off the pad

name: Cable Triceps Pushdown
steps: Stand at a high cable with a rope or bar.
Elbows pinned to your sides, push down until the arms are straight.
Let the forearms rise slowly.

name: Lying Triceps Extension
steps: Lie on a bench holding an EZ-bar over the chest.
Bend only the elbows to lower the bar towards the forehead.
Straighten the arms.

name: Close-grip Bench Press
steps: Grip the bar about shoulder-width.
Lower to the lower chest, elbows tucked.
Press up.

name: Wrist Curl
steps: Sit with forearms on the thighs, wrists past the knees.
Curl the dumbbells up using only the wrists.
Lower slowly.

name: Barbell Back Squat
steps: Bar on the upper back, feet shoulder-width, toes slightly out.
Brace, then sit down between your hips.
Go to at least parallel with a neutral back.
Drive up through the whole foot.

name: Front Squat
steps: Bar on the front of the shoulders, elbows high.
Squat down keeping the torso upright.
Drive up, elbows staying high.

name: Leg Press
steps: Sit with the back flat, feet shoulder-width on the platform.
Lower until the knees are about 90°.
Press up without locking the knees.
mistakes: Lower back lifting off the seat

name: Leg Extension
steps: Sit with the pad on the front of the ankles.
Straighten the knees fully.
Lower slowly.

name: Leg Curl
steps: Lie face down (or sit) with the pad behind the ankles.
Curl the heels towards the glutes.
Lower slowly.

name: Romanian Deadlift
steps: Stand holding the weight at the thighs.
Push the hips back with soft knees, sliding the weight down the legs.
Stop when you feel a strong hamstring stretch, flat back.
Squeeze the glutes to stand.
mistakes: Bending the knees too much (becomes a squat)

name: Bulgarian Split Squat
steps: Rear foot on a bench, front foot a stride ahead.
Drop straight down until the front thigh is parallel.
Drive up through the front heel.

name: Hack Squat
steps: Back against the pad, shoulders under the supports.
Lower until thighs are parallel.
Press up without locking out.

name: Seated Calf Raise
steps: Sit with the pad on the thighs, balls of the feet on the step.
Lower the heels for a stretch.
Rise as high as possible, pause.

name: Hip Thrust
steps: Upper back on a bench, bar over the hips (use a pad).
Feet flat, chin tucked.
Drive the hips up until the body is flat from shoulders to knees; squeeze.
Lower with control.

name: Cable Glute Kickback
steps: Attach an ankle strap to a low cable; hold the machine.
Kick the leg straight back, squeezing the glute.
Return slowly without arching.

name: Hip Abduction Machine
steps: Sit with the pads on the outside of the knees.
Push the knees apart.
Return slowly.

name: Kettlebell Swing
steps: Hinge and hike the kettlebell back between your legs.
Snap the hips forward to swing it to chest height.
Let it fall back and hinge again.

name: Pallof Press
steps: Stand side-on to a cable at chest height.
Hold the handle at your chest and press it straight out.
Resist the twist, pause, bring it back.

name: Cable Crunch
steps: Kneel at a high cable holding the rope beside your head.
Crunch down, bringing the ribs towards the hips.
Return slowly.

name: Hanging Knee Raise
steps: Hang from a bar (or use the captain's chair).
Bring the knees up towards the chest without swinging.
Lower slowly.

name: Ab Wheel Rollout
steps: Kneel holding the wheel under the shoulders.
Roll forward slowly, keeping the hips in line.
Pull back using the abs.

name: Treadmill (Incline Walk / Jog)
steps: Start slow, then raise the speed or incline.
Walk or jog upright without holding the rails.
Cool down for the last 3–5 minutes.

name: Cross Trainer (Elliptical)
steps: Step on and hold the moving handles.
Push and pull with arms and legs in a smooth rhythm.
Keep the posture upright.
mistakes: Going too slow to raise the heart rate

name: Stationary Bike
steps: Set the seat so the knee is slightly bent at the bottom.
Pedal at a steady pace; add resistance as you improve.
Try intervals: 30 s hard, 90 s easy.

name: Rowing Machine
steps: Start with knees bent, arms straight, leaning slightly forward.
Push with the legs, then lean back, then pull the handle to the ribs.
Return: arms, body, then legs.

name: Stair Climber
steps: Step at a steady pace using the whole foot.
Stand tall; rest the hands lightly on the rails only for balance.
Increase speed gradually.

name: Farmer's Walk
steps: Pick up heavy dumbbells, one in each hand.
Walk tall with short, quick steps.
Keep the shoulders back and core tight.

name: Dumbbell Thruster
steps: Hold dumbbells at the shoulders.
Squat down, then drive up and press the weights overhead in one motion.
Lower to the shoulders as you squat again.

name: Kettlebell Clean & Press
steps: Hinge and pull the weight up to the shoulder in one smooth motion.
Press it overhead.
Lower to the shoulder, then back down.

name: Cat–Cow
hinglish: marjari asana, cat cow, billi aasan
steps: Come onto hands and knees, wrists under shoulders, knees under hips.
Inhale: drop the belly, lift the chest and gaze (cow).
Exhale: round the back and tuck the chin (cat).
Move slowly with the breath.

name: Neck & Shoulder Release
steps: Sit tall, shoulders relaxed.
Slowly tilt the head side to side, then forward and back.
Roll the shoulders backwards a few times.
Keep every movement slow and pain-free.

name: Shoulder Rotation
steps: Sit tall, fingertips on the shoulders.
Draw big circles with the elbows.
Reverse after 10 rounds; breathe slowly.

name: Sun Salutation
steps: Stand in prayer pose, then sweep the arms up and fold forward.
Step back into a lunge, then plank, lower down (8-point pose) and lift into cobra.
Lift the hips into downward dog, step forward to a lunge and fold.
Rise with arms up and return to prayer. Repeat on the other leg.
benefits: Warms and stretches the whole body

name: Prayer Pose
steps: Stand with feet together, weight even.
Bring the palms together in front of the chest.
Relax the shoulders and breathe slowly.

name: Raised Arms Pose
steps: From prayer pose, inhale and sweep the arms overhead.
Lift the chest and lean back slightly, hips steady.
Keep the neck long.
mistakes: Bending only at the lower back

name: Low Lunge
steps: From a forward fold, step one leg far back and lower the knee.
Hands beside the front foot, front knee over the ankle.
Lift the chest and look forward.

name: Eight-limbed Pose
steps: From plank, lower the knees to the floor.
Lower the chest and chin between the hands, hips slightly up.
Eight points touch: feet, knees, chest, chin and hands.

name: Mountain Pose
hinglish: tadasana, tad asan, taadasan, palm tree pose
steps: Stand tall with feet together or hip-width apart.
Spread the toes, weight even across both feet.
Lift through the crown; for the palm-tree version raise the arms and rise onto the toes.
Breathe steadily.

name: Warrior I
steps: Step one foot back, turning it out slightly.
Bend the front knee over the ankle.
Square the hips forward and raise the arms overhead.
Hold, breathing deeply; switch sides.
avoid_if: high blood pressure (keep arms on hips)

name: Warrior II
steps: Stand with feet wide, front foot turned out.
Bend the front knee over the ankle.
Stretch the arms out at shoulder height and gaze over the front hand.
Hold, then switch sides.

name: Triangle Pose
steps: Stand with feet wide, front foot turned out.
Reach forward, then lower the hand to the shin or a block.
Raise the other arm to the ceiling; open the chest.
Keep both legs straight. Switch sides.

name: Extended Side Angle
steps: From Warrior II, rest the front forearm on the thigh (or hand to the floor).
Reach the top arm over the ear.
Make one long line from back heel to fingertips.

name: Chair Pose
steps: Stand with feet together.
Bend the knees and sit back as if on a chair, weight in the heels.
Raise the arms alongside the ears.

name: Goddess Pose
steps: Stand with feet wide, toes turned out.
Bend the knees over the toes and lower the hips.
Arms in a cactus shape, chest lifted.

name: Standing Backward Bend
steps: Stand with feet together, hands supporting the lower back.
Inhale and gently bend backwards from the upper back.
Keep the knees straight; come up slowly.
mistakes: Bending only at the lower back

name: Standing Spinal Twist
steps: Stand with feet apart, arms at shoulder height.
Twist the waist to one side, wrapping the arms around the body.
Look over the shoulder, then twist to the other side.

name: Wide-legged Forward Bend
hinglish: prasarita padottanasana, wide leg forward bend
steps: Stand with feet wide, hands on hips.
Fold forward from the hips with a long back.
Place the hands on the floor; let the head hang.

name: Tree Pose
steps: Stand on one leg, the other foot on the inner calf or thigh (not the knee).
Press foot and leg together.
Bring the palms together at the chest or overhead and gaze at one point.

name: Warrior III
steps: Stand on one leg and hinge forward.
Lift the back leg until body and leg form a line.
Reach the arms forward; keep the hips level.
mistakes: Hip of the lifted leg opening up

name: Eagle Pose
steps: Bend the knees slightly and cross one thigh over the other.
Wrap the arms, one elbow over the other.
Sink lower and keep the chest lifted.

name: Dancer Pose
steps: Stand on one leg, hold the other ankle behind you.
Reach the free arm forward.
Kick the foot into the hand and tilt the chest forward.

name: Cobra Pose
steps: Lie face down, hands under the shoulders.
Press lightly and lift the chest, elbows bent and close.
Shoulders away from the ears; lower slowly.

name: Sphinx Pose
steps: Lie face down, forearms on the floor, elbows under shoulders.
Lift the chest gently.
Relax the legs and breathe.

name: Bridge Pose
steps: Lie on your back, knees bent, feet hip-width.
Press the feet down and lift the hips.
Interlace the hands under you; keep the neck still.

name: Camel Pose
steps: Kneel with knees hip-width, hands on the lower back.
Lift the chest and lean back, hips over the knees.
Reach for the heels if comfortable; come up slowly.
benefits: Opens the chest and hip flexors

name: Bow Pose
steps: Lie face down, bend the knees and hold the ankles.
Kick the feet into the hands to lift chest and thighs.
Breathe; lower slowly.

name: Locust Pose
steps: Lie face down, arms by your sides.
Lift the legs, chest and arms off the floor.
Keep the neck long; lower slowly.

name: Upward-facing Dog
steps: From lying face down, press up on straight arms.
Lift the thighs off the floor, tops of feet down.
Open the chest, shoulders down.

name: Fish Pose
steps: Lie on your back, hands under the hips.
Press the forearms down and lift the chest.
Rest the crown of the head lightly on the floor.

name: Seated Forward Bend
steps: Sit with legs straight forward.
Inhale to lengthen; exhale and fold from the hips.
Hold the shins or feet; keep the back long.
mistakes: Rounding hard to reach the toes

name: Standing Forward Bend
steps: Stand with feet hip-width.
Fold forward from the hips; bend the knees as needed.
Let the head and arms hang; rise slowly.
benefits: Stretches the back of the legs

name: Head-to-knee Pose
steps: Sit with one leg straight, the other foot on the inner thigh.
Turn towards the straight leg.
Fold forward over it with a long back.
mistakes: Forcing the head to the knee

name: Staff Pose
steps: Sit with legs straight together.
Hands beside the hips, press down to sit tall.
Flex the feet and press the thighs down.

name: Butterfly / Bound Angle
steps: Sit tall, bring the soles of the feet together.
Hold the feet and let the knees drop.
Gently flap the knees like butterfly wings, or hold still.
mistakes: Pushing the knees down with force

name: Easy Pose
steps: Sit cross-legged, hands on the knees.
Lengthen the spine, relax the shoulders.
Sit on a cushion if the knees are high.
benefits: Comfortable seat for breathing and meditation

name: Lotus Pose
steps: Sit and place one foot on the opposite thigh, then the other.
Rest the hands on the knees.
Sit tall; use half-lotus if the knees complain.

name: Thunderbolt Pose
steps: Kneel and sit back on your heels, big toes touching.
Hands on the thighs, spine tall.
Breathe slowly.
mistakes: Sitting on painful knees (add a cushion)
benefits: Traditionally done after meals to support digestion

name: Cow Face Pose
steps: Sit and stack one knee over the other.
Reach one arm up and bend it behind the head, the other behind the back.
Clasp the fingers (or hold a towel).

name: Garland Pose (Yogic Squat)
steps: Squat with feet wider than hips, heels down (use a folded mat under the heels if needed).
Press the elbows against the inner knees, palms together.
Lengthen the spine.

name: Frog Pose (Mandukasana)
steps: Sit in Vajrasana and make fists, pressing them into the belly beside the navel.
Exhale and bend forward over the fists.
Hold, then rise slowly.

name: Half Lord of the Fishes
aliases: Half Lord of the Fishes (Ardha Matsyendrasana)
steps: Sit, bend one knee and place that foot outside the other knee.
Lengthen up, then twist towards the bent knee.
Hug the knee or hook the elbow outside it.

name: Supine Twist
steps: Lie on your back, arms out wide.
Draw one knee across the body to the floor.
Keep both shoulders heavy; look the other way.

name: Downward-facing Dog
hinglish: adho mukha svanasana, downward dog, parvatasana
steps: From hands and knees, lift the hips up and back.
Press the hands down, lengthen the spine.
Heels reach towards the floor (bend the knees if needed).
benefits: Stretches the back of the body

name: Legs up the Wall
steps: Sit sideways to a wall, then swing the legs up as you lie back.
Rest the arms by your sides.
Breathe slowly; bend the knees to come out.

name: Shoulder Stand
steps: Lie on your back and lift the legs and hips up.
Support the back with the hands, elbows on the floor.
Straighten the body up; keep the neck still. Come down slowly.
benefits: Classic inversion in Indian yoga practice

name: Plough Pose
steps: From shoulder stand, lower the feet over the head towards the floor.
Keep the arms on the floor or support the back.
Roll down slowly, vertebra by vertebra.
mistakes: Forcing the feet to the floor
benefits: Deep stretch for the spine and hamstrings

name: Boat Pose
steps: Sit with knees bent, lean back slightly.
Lift the feet and balance on the sit bones.
Straighten the legs if you can; arms forward.

name: Plank Pose
steps: From hands and knees, step the feet back.
Hands under shoulders, body in one straight line.
Breathe steadily.

name: Four-limbed Staff
steps: From plank, shift forward slightly.
Lower until elbows are at 90°, close to the ribs.
Hold the body straight; lower knees to make it easier.
mistakes: Dropping the shoulders below the elbows

name: Side Plank
steps: From plank, turn onto one hand and the side of one foot.
Lift the hips and raise the top arm.
Lower the bottom knee to make it easier.
benefits: Strengthens the side body and shoulders

name: Child's Pose
steps: Kneel, big toes together, knees apart or together.
Sit back on the heels and fold forward.
Rest the forehead down, arms forward or by your sides.
mistakes: Forcing the hips to the heels

name: Corpse Pose
steps: Lie on your back, legs apart, arms slightly away from the body.
Close the eyes and let the body feel heavy.
Breathe naturally; relax from toes to head.

name: Crocodile Pose
steps: Lie face down, legs apart.
Fold the arms and rest the forehead on them.
Breathe into the belly and relax.

name: Wind-relieving Pose
steps: Lie on your back and hug both knees to the chest.
Optionally lift the head towards the knees.
Rock gently side to side.

name: Happy Baby
steps: Lie on your back, knees towards the armpits.
Hold the outer feet, soles to the ceiling.
Rock gently.

name: Alternate Nostril Breathing
steps: Sit comfortably with a tall spine.
Close the right nostril with the thumb and breathe in through the left.
Close the left with the ring finger, breathe out through the right; then in through the right.
Continue alternating, slow and even.

name: Skull-shining Breath
steps: Sit tall, hands on the knees.
Breathe out sharply through the nose by pulling the belly in.
Let the inhale happen on its own. Start slowly.
Rest between rounds.

name: Humming Bee Breath
steps: Sit tall, close the ears with the thumbs (fingers over the eyes optional).
Breathe in through the nose.
Breathe out making a steady humming sound.

name: Victorious Breath
steps: Sit tall and breathe through the nose.
Gently narrow the back of the throat so the breath makes a soft ocean sound.
Make the inhale and exhale long and even.

name: Cooling Breath
steps: Sit tall; roll the tongue into a tube.
Breathe in through the tongue, feeling the cool air.
Close the mouth and breathe out through the nose.

name: Bellows Breath
steps: Sit tall, hands on the knees.
Breathe in and out forcefully and equally through the nose.
Rest with normal breathing between rounds.
